items.source: A flag to skip the SourceFile, SourceDebugExtension, LocalVariableTable, LocalVariableTypeTable, LineNumberTable and MethodParameters attributes. If this flag is set these attributes are neither parsed nor visited (i.e. ClassVisitor.visitSource(String, String), MethodVisitor.visitLocalVariable(String, String, String, Label, Label, int), MethodVisitor.visitLineNumber(int, Label) and MethodVisitor.visitParameter(String, int) are not called).

items.source: A parser to make a ClassVisitor visit a ClassFile structure, as defined in the Java Virtual Machine Specification (JVMS). This class parses the ClassFile content and calls the appropriate visit methods of a given ClassVisitor for each field, method and bytecode instruction encountered.
items.translation: 一个解析器，用于使 `ClassVisitor` 访问如 Java 虚拟机规范 (JVMS) 中定义的 ClassFile 结构。该类解析 ClassFile 内容，并为遇到的每个字段、方法和字节码指令调用给定 `ClassVisitor` 的相应访问方法。

items.source: A flag to skip the StackMap and StackMapTable attributes. If this flag is set these attributes are neither parsed nor visited (i.e. MethodVisitor.visitFrame(int, int, Object[], int, Object[]) is not called). This flag is useful when the ClassWriter.COMPUTE_FRAMES option is used: it avoids visiting frames that will be ignored and recomputed from scratch.
items.translation: 一个用于跳过 StackMap 和 StackMapTable 属性的标志。如果设置了此标志，则不会解析或访问这些属性（即 MethodVisitor.visitFrame(int, int, Object[], int, Object[]) 不会被调用）。当使用 ClassWriter.COMPUTE_FRAMES 选项时，此标志非常有用：它避免了访问那些将被忽略并从头重新计算的帧。

items.source: Returns the internal name of the super class (see Type.getInternalName()). For interfaces, the super class is Object.
items.translation: 返回父类的内部名称（参见Type.getInternalName()）。对于接口，父类是Object。

items.source: Handles the bytecode offset of the next instruction to be visited in accept(ClassVisitor,int). This method is called just before the instruction and before its associated label and stack map frame, if any. The default implementation of this method does nothing. Subclasses can override this method to store the argument in a mutable field, for instance, so that MethodVisitor instances can get the bytecode offset of each visited instruction (if so, the usual concurrency issues related to mutable data should be addressed).
items.translation: 处理下一个要访问的指令在 accept(ClassVisitor,int) 中的字节码偏移量。此方法在指令之前以及其关联的标签和栈映射帧（如果有）之前调用。此方法的默认实现什么都不做。子类可以重写此方法将参数存储在可变字段中，例如，以便 MethodVisitor 实例能够获取每个访问指令的字节码偏移量（如果是这样，则应解决与可变数据相关的通常并发问题）。

items.translation: ClassFile 的 access_flags 字段的字节偏移量。

items.translation: 返回类常量池表中的条目数量。

items.translation: 返回类常量池表中包含的字符串的最大长度的保守估计值。

items.source:
A flag to skip the Code attributes. If this flag is set the Code attributes are neither parsed
nor visited.
items.translation: 一个用于跳过代码属性的标志。如果设置了此标志，则不对代码属性进行解析或访问。

items.source:
A flag to expand the stack map frames. By default stack map frames are visited in their
original format (i.e. "expanded" for classes whose version is less than V1_6, and "compressed"
for the other classes). If this flag is set, stack map frames are always visited in expanded
format (this option adds a decompression/compression step in ClassReader and ClassWriter which
degrades performance quite a lot).
items.translation: 一个用于展开栈映射帧的标志。默认情况下，栈映射帧以其原始格式被访问（即，对于版本小于 V1_6 的类为“展开”格式，而对于其他类为“压缩”格式）。如果设置此标志，栈映射帧将始终以展开格式被访问（此选项在 ClassReader 和 ClassWriter 中添加了解压/压缩步骤，这会显著降低性能）。

items.source: A byte array containing the JVMS ClassFile structure to be parsed.
items.translation: 包含待解析的 JVMS ClassFile 结构的字节数组。

items.source:
Returns the label corresponding to the given bytecode offset. The default implementation of
this method creates a label for the given offset if it has not been already created.
items.translation: 返回给定字节码偏移量对应的标签。此方法的默认实现会在该偏移量的标签尚未创建时为其创建一个标签。

items.source: the Integer, Float, Long, Double, String, Type, Handle or ConstantDynamic corresponding to the specified constant pool entry.
items.translation: `Integer`、`Float`、`Long`、`Double`、`String`、`Type`、`Handle` 或 `ConstantDynamic`，对应于指定的常量池条目。

items.source: className - the fully qualified name of the class to be read. The ClassFile structure is retrieved with the current class loader's ClassLoader.getSystemResourceAsStream(String).
items.translation: className - 要读取的类的完全限定名称。ClassFile 结构通过当前类加载器的 ClassLoader.getSystemResourceAsStream(String) 获取。

items.translation: `offset` - 在此ClassReader中要读取的字节流的起始偏移量。

items.translation: offset - 此 ClassReader 中无符号短整型值的起始偏移量，其值为类常量池表中 CONSTANT_Utf8 条目的索引。

items.source: offset - the start offset of an unsigned short value in this ClassReader, whose value is the index of a CONSTANT_Class entry in class's constant pool table.
items.translation: offset - 此ClassReader中无符号短整型值的起始偏移量，其值为类常量池表中 CONSTANT_Class 条目的索引。

items.source: offset - the start offset of an unsigned short value in this ClassReader, whose value is the index of a CONSTANT_Module entry in class's constant pool table.

items.source: IOException - if a problem occurs during reading.
items.translation: IOException - 如果在读取过程中出现问题。

items.source: IOException - if an exception occurs during reading.
items.translation: IOException - 如果在读取过程中发生异常。

items.source: the internal name of the super class, or null for Object class.
items.translation: 超类的内部名称，或者对于 Object 类为 null。

items.source: attributePrototypes - prototypes of the attributes that must be parsed during the visit of the class. Any attribute whose type is not equal to the type of one the prototypes will not be parsed: its byte array value will be passed unchanged to the ClassWriter. This may corrupt it if this value contains references to the constant pool, or has syntactic or semantic links with a class element that has been transformed by a class adapter between the reader and the writer.
items.translation: attributePrototypes - 在访问类时必须解析的属性原型。任何类型与这些原型之一不相等的属性都不会被解析：其字节数组值将原样传递给 ClassWriter。如果该值包含对常量池的引用，或者具有与类适配器（位于读取器和写入器之间）转换过的类元素之间的语法或语义链接，这可能会导致数据损坏。

items.source: the start offset in this ClassReader of the corresponding JVMS 'cp_info' structure, plus one.
items.translation: 此 `ClassReader` 中对应的 JVMS 'cp_info' 结构的起始偏移量加一。

items.translation: classFile - 要读取的 JVMS ClassFile 结构。

items.source: classFileBuffer - a byte array containing the JVMS ClassFile structure to be read.
items.translation: classFileBuffer - 一个包含待读取的 JVMS ClassFile 结构的字节数组。

items.source: classFileOffset - the offset in byteBuffer of the first byte of the ClassFile to be read.
items.translation: classFileOffset - 要读取的 ClassFile 的第一个字节在 byteBuffer 中的偏移量。

items.source: classFileLength - the length in bytes of the ClassFile to be read.
items.translation: classFileLength - 要读取的 ClassFile 的长度（以字节为单位）。

items.source: inputStream - an input stream of the JVMS ClassFile structure to be read. This input stream must contain nothing more than the ClassFile structure itself. It is read from its current position to its end.
items.translation: `inputStream` - 要读取的 JVMS ClassFile 结构的输入流。此输入流必须仅包含 ClassFile 结构本身。它从其当前位置读取到末尾。

items.source: bytecodeOffset - the bytecode offset of the next instruction to be visited.
items.translation: bytecodeOffset - 下一个要访问指令的字节码偏移量。

items.source: labels - the already created labels, indexed by their offset. If a label already exists for bytecodeOffset this method must not create a new one. Otherwise it must store the new label in this array.
items.translation: `labels` - 已创建的标签，按偏移量索引。如果字节码偏移处已存在标签，则此方法不得创建新标签；否则，必须将此新标签存储到该数组中。

items.source: constantPoolEntryIndex - the index a constant pool entry in the class's constant pool table.
items.translation: constantPoolEntryIndex - 类常量池表中常量池条目的索引。

items.source: length - the number of bytes to read.
items.translation: length - 要读取的字节数。

items.source: charBuffer - the buffer to be used to read the string. This buffer must be sufficiently large. It is not automatically resized.
items.translation: charBuffer - 用于读取字符串的缓冲区。该缓冲区必须足够大，且不会自动调整大小。

items.source: constantPoolEntryIndex - the index of a CONSTANT_Integer, CONSTANT_Float, CONSTANT_Long, CONSTANT_Double, CONSTANT_Class, CONSTANT_String, CONSTANT_MethodType, CONSTANT_MethodHandle or CONSTANT_Dynamic entry in the class's constant pool.
items.translation: constantPoolEntryIndex - 类常量池中 CONSTANT_Integer、CONSTANT_Float、CONSTANT_Long、CONSTANT_Double、CONSTANT_Class、CONSTANT_String、CONSTANT_MethodType、CONSTANT_MethodHandle 或 CONSTANT_Dynamic 条目的索引。
